scope.description: Public Node configuration proposal admission during finite ordered application deferral after completed Ready persistence.
assumptions: Serialized Node event loop and public API calls.
Ready entries, HardState and snapshots are saved before Advance; no early outbound response delivery.
Caller eventually activates the first configuration and preserves inter-Ready application order; the first configuration is not rejected.
Configuration validation enabled; simple configuration changes outside joint state; stable leader during the selected interval.
excluded: General election safety, divergent application results or quorum intersection proof
Eventual success of a permitted proposal

parameters.faults: No crash; newly added peers may be absent

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: MemoryStorage substitutes for device persistence under a no-crash model.
New peers are absent and outbound network messages are dropped.
Caller booleans record returned configuration activation calls; public Status is an event-loop processing barrier. No target code or dependency substitutions.

plan_uncertainties: The Node early-Advance permission and mandatory ApplyConfChange wording require correspondence review; observations alone do not settle normative precedence.
Only the selected no-crash simple-configuration admission interval is checked. No divergent decisions, crash durability or general liveness property is tested.
A direct proposal error produces driver incompletion, not a false violation; no timeout means rejection oracle is used.
grounding_unresolved: The immediate-before-Advance reading of ApplyConfChange whenever observed would constrain the explicit numbered permission; correspondence must address this counterinterpretation.

Node.ApplyConfChange whenever observed might be read as requiring immediate activation before Advance. The check selects the explicit numbered Node step-order permission; this interpretation must be assessed during correspondence.
Same selected Node early-Advance interpretation as Harness legality; a contrary applicability ruling would limit attribution, not change the measured entry type.
